Name: Pretty Cows
Author: linodibev
Description:
Improves the White Cow textures with a whiter base colour and a more realistic minimal colour-sided pattern, and the Brown Cow textures with a more realistic red spotted pattern.

Also slightly adjusts the sprite in following ways:

[list]
[*]improved muzzle & udder colour
[*]resting/ruminating: improved mouth, closed eyes
[*]mooing/being petted: improved eyes
[*]rear view: horns set farther apart to match other views
[/list]
Additional options are coming up, depending on interest:
[list]
[*]all-red Brown Cow, with or without small white markings
[*]black spotted White Cow
[*]medium colour-sided pattern for either Cow
[/list]

Downloads.Description: replacement XNBs for both Cows and Baby Cows
